headline: Your Mac Quietly Maps Your Relationships
lede: Since macOS 13, background daemons have assembled a personal knowledge graph from messages, photos, calendars, locations, and more. The data sits in plaintext SQLite databases, turning local convenience into a concentrated privacy risk.

headline: Libghostty Reaches Stable ABI
lede: Libghostty 1.0 ships a portable terminal-emulation library with a stable C ABI. Versioned symbols, opaque handles, signed source packages, and broad platform support make terminal infrastructure embeddable—and maintainable.

headline: Please Upload Your RAM
lede: A mock service invites you to donate unused memory to the cloud. The joke lands on a serious fault line: as AI infrastructure centralizes, the machine on your desk starts looking like an inconvenient local resource.

headline: Underground 2 Finds a New Browser Life
lede: A community project brings Need for Speed Underground 2 to modern browsers, phones, and Steam Decks. It adds widescreen rendering, cloud saves, online free roam, multiplayer races, and a fresh layer of engineering around an old game.

headline: Cheap Judgment, Frontier Accuracy
lede: A smaller model screens identity-resolution cases and sends uncertain decisions to Claude Opus. The hybrid reaches near-Opus accuracy while reducing the number of expensive calls—a routing strategy, not a miracle.

headline: The Cybertruck Runs Out Of Road
lede: Tesla plans to wind down Cybertruck production around mid-2027, making room for Cybercab output. Sales missed the company’s forecast, while the truck’s specialized design and regulatory constraints narrowed its market further.

headline: Enterprise Memory Needs A Ledger
lede: AmpUp’s Enterprise Brain treats agent memory as governed operational data: versioned, permissioned, auditable, and stored in customer-controlled environments. Its promise is reproducibility, but self-reported gains and uneven benchmarks keep the accounting unfinished.
pullquote: Agent memory becomes useful only when organizations can inspect, govern, and retrain it.

headline: Port Zero Is A Useful Non-Port
lede: Port 0 is reserved, unusual, and generally not a destination for ordinary traffic. Yet asking the operating system for port 0 remains a practical way to obtain an available ephemeral port for parallel tests.

headline: How Agents Learn What To Remember
lede: Anthropic’s experiments frame memory as curated experience rather than an ever-growing transcript. Agents record salient notes, then use offline dreaming to test, reorganize, and connect them—while stale memories and maintenance costs remain central problems.

headline: Ancient DNA Revives A Gothic Origin
lede: New genetic evidence supports a substantial Scandinavian migration into northern Poland during the spread of Gothic culture. The later story is less tidy: migration gives way to intermarriage, elite transmission, and traditions carried across changing confederacies.
